informal_statement:
If
\[
f:\mathbb R\to X
\]
is injective on \(S\),
\[
u\leq v,
\]
and
\[
[u,v]\subseteq S,
\]
then
\[
f([u,v))=f([u,v])\setminus\{f(v)\}.
\]
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:124-141`: Injectivity is assumed only on a set containing the closed interval, and the half-open image removes exactly the final image point.
